ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark gray/black pixels; primarily a Type 5 pigmentation pattern.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field across both lobes. Sparse, high-contrast white focal spots (1-3 pixel diameter) localized in the lower-central region near the peduncle and scattered along the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 125-degree shallow U-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with distinct larger indentations (approx. 10-15 pixels deep) located at the 25% and 75% marks of the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to rounded lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered high-contrast white pixel clusters on the central and right lobes, likely representing small barnacle scars or pigmentation anomalies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge; one horizontal linear streak on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable linear scarring on the dorsal-ventral transition of the right lobe; irregular material loss (notching) on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
